source_summary: CMT Orange Tools USA catalog 2026 (PDF): CNC solid carbide spirals (190/191/192/195/196/198/812, DLCS-coated .41 versions), 152 tapered ball nose, 199 ball nose, 140 PCD compression, 178/663 spoilboard surfacing, 663.1 V-groove insert cutters, and router-section V-groove (815, 858, 849, 665) and bowl (851) bits without bearings. CMT publishes no chip-load chart; the only cutting data is one test (1/2 in compression, 18,000 RPM, 20 m/min in 19 mm melamine chipboard). Bearing-guided (B) versions and solid-surface bits without a flute count were left out.
